name: Mycel
tagline: Bring one past deliverable. Mycel drafts every future one.
description: Mycel runs the work your service business sells - clients, deliverables, approvals, invoices. Each job runs in a disposable sandbox that never holds a credential, and nothing reaches a client until you approve it. From $299/mo, or self-host free.

name: Minicart
tagline: Launch your store. Let AI run the busywork.
description: Minicart helps makers, creators, and resellers launch and run an online store without learning ecommerce software. Minicart gives you a store and an AI team to help run it. Sloane manages your storefront, Milo creates marketing, and Logan handles logistics and customer replies. Add products, update inventory, create promotions, ship orders, and more by simply chatting with your team. Just tell your team what you need in plain language, review their work, and keep building your business.

name: Answers by Context.dev
tagline: Give it a research task + the JSON shape you want back.
description: Answers by Context.dev turns web research into a single API call. Define a task and your desired JSON structure. Answers finds sources, researches the web, and returns structured data with source URLs. Build enrichment pipelines, comparison tools, and research agents without stitching together search, scraping, and LLM calls.

name: Morsa Signals
tagline: GTM and AI visibility workflows for developer tools
description: Morsa Signals gives developer-tool founders and GTM teams practical GTM and SEO/GEO workflows in one place. Find relevant developers for scaled outreach, identify potential first users and early adopters, audit how AI search systems understand your site, and get a first read on competitors worth tracking. Each workflow starts from your actual product and produces a focused, actionable result instead of a generic report or database.

name: Harbor
tagline: The Evernote alternative that puts its price in writing
description: A private second brain: notes, scans, PDFs and recordings, searchable with OCR, handwriting included. One-step Evernote import. Native on Mac, Windows, iPhone, iPad, Android, web and CLI. Full export on every plan. Price locked 3 years, then a 10%/yr cap.

name: Termphin
tagline: SSH client with sessions that never drop.
description: SSH that survives a locked phone, a lost signal or a switch to mobile data. A small agent holds the shell open on the server and puts you back on the same screen. htop and vim draw properly. SFTP, keys, snippets and tunnels included, free.

name: The 101 Plays Itself
tagline: Five lanes of LA highway turned into an instrument
description: A live Caltrans traffic camera on the US-101 in Studio City, playing itself as music in your browser. Real traffic on the southbound 101, this minute. Every car that crosses the line plays a note, and the music is being made in your browser as they go past.

name: Launchie 1.6.1
tagline: Launchpad Replacement for MacOS 27 Golden Gate
description: Apple removed Launchpad in macOS 26 and kept it out of 27. Launchie brings the grid back: arrange apps your way, unlimited folders, Spaces for separate app pages, and instant search. Free to use, Pro is a one-time purchase. Mac App Store and Homebrew.

name: ManyPI
tagline: 10x your revenue by finding your ideal customers
description: Define your ideal customer. ManyPI finds them on the live web, verifies their email, validates their pain points and emotional buying triggers, then sends hyper-personalized outreach that turns those signals into sales.

name: Epismo OS
tagline: Keep your work when you switch AI tools
description: Epismo keeps your team’s AI work in a Case: the result, the decisions behind it, reviews, and the next step. Switch between AI tools or teammates without a re-brief. Auto review gives a saved result a fresh review, flags issues, and leaves the original unchanged.

name: YABAI
tagline: Real Japanese slang, one giant word at a time
description: Textbooks teach Japanese that stops at the classroom door. YABAI is the other half: 308 real slang, internet and fandom words, each on a card built around giant Japanese typography. Every word has a meaning, a real example, a vibe check (safe to use? friends only? careful?) and a story — and when the origin is uncertain, it says so instead of inventing one. Built end to end with AI agents in Claude Code. 13 languages, works offline. No streaks, no tests, no XP.

name: Embedful
tagline: Launch customer dashboards in minutes
description: Embedful helps SaaS teams build and launch customer dashboards in minutes. Connect your existing data, create secure customer-facing dashboards, and embed personalized analytics directly into your product. With Embedful, you can deliver embedded analytics without building and maintaining a complex analytics platform or dashboard infrastructure yourself.

name: SmartPause
tagline: The play/pause key, finally aimed at what's playing
description: macOS routes the media key to whatever it last remembers, so YouTube keeps playing and Apple Music opens. SmartPause finds the app actually outputting audio and pauses that. Two apps playing? One press switches, double press plays/pauses. Free, open source, menu bar only.

name: Scrapboard Cloud 4
tagline: Digital family refrigerator door, now pocket-sized n synced
description: With a 12-year heritage behind the Scrapboard series, Scrapboard Cloud 4 brings the classic concept of a digital bulletin board—recreating the cozy feel of a family refrigerator door—right to your iOS devices. Designed to work hand-in-hand with its macOS counterpart (Scrapboard 4), this app lets you seamlessly sync and share your creative boards across all your iPads, iPhones, and Macs using your iCloud account.

name: findable 2.0
tagline: Help your agency clients to #1 on ChatGPT, Google, Claude
description: Help your agency clients get to #1 on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini

name: Aymo AI for Chrome
tagline: Free AI Sidebar in Your Browser with Tools and Top AI Models
description: Free AI browser extension that puts 50+ top AI models and tools in a sidebar, one click away. GPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Kimi, Gemini and top AI models available today, all in one place. Works on Chrome, Brave, Edge, and other Chromium browsers. Ask questions about the page you're reading, use AI quick actions, create or optimize content, post and reply on social media, write and reply to emails, and get your everyday knowledge work done faster and better.

name: Awnsy
tagline: Offline AI translator for Mac. Press ⌘C twice, done.
description: Awnsy is a small menu bar translator for macOS. Select text in any app, press ⌘C twice, and the translation appears right over the window. For text you can't select, like images, scanned PDFs or video, drag a box around it and Awnsy reads and translates it. The translation model lives inside the app and runs on your Mac. No account, no API key, works offline, and what you translate stays on your machine. If you prefer cloud quality, add your own OpenAI or Anthropic key.

name: Creads
tagline: Your marketing, running on its own
description: A full marketing team that runs itself. Chat and agents with real roles handle ads, organic and research on autopilot — they create, publish, optimize. You get the outcome, not the workflow. Free 3-day trial.

name: Soar90™
tagline: Personal 30-60-90 day onboarding plan for any new job
description: New job? The first 90 days are too important to leave to chance. Soar90™ is the only personal, self-guided onboarding platform built for new hires. Choose from multiple role-specific tracks, customize your plan, complete daily tasks, log wins, and generate review-ready performance reports in one click or create your own. Use it standalone or alongside any company onboarding. One-time purchase. You got the job, now crush your first 90 days! Also perfect as gift from recruiter or employer.

name: Chain Your Mac
tagline: The scrolling window manager for macOS.
description: A native scrolling window manager for macOS: windows on an endless strip, like Niri or PaperWM. Trackpad swipe, stacks, no SIP, macOS 13+. Try the live demo.
